prompt_en: A clean, elegant iPhone app UI mockup for a Chinese perpetual calendar and almanac app, shown as a full-screen mobile screenshot on a soft warm white background with subtle paper-like texture and refined East Asian editorial aesthetics. The interface uses a minimalist serif-and-sans mix, muted brown, gray, black, pale blue, green, and gold accents, with spacious layout and delicate dividers. Show the iOS status bar at the top with the time 8:45, cellular signal, Wi‑Fi icon, and a battery indicator reading 96. Below it, a header for 4月 with secondary text “24日 | 每日万年历” and, on the right, a rounded rectangular date-picker button labeled “择日” with a calendar icon plus a separate plus symbol. The main section is a monthly calendar grid for 2026, with 7 weekday columns labeled Sunday through Saturday in Chinese: 周日, 周一, 周二, 周三, 周四, 周五, 周六. Render a 6-row month view with exactly 42 date cells including adjacent-month dates. The visible dates should be: first row 29, 30, 31, 1, 2, 3, 4; second row 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; third row 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18; fourth row 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25; fifth row 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 1, 2; sixth row 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Each day cell includes a large Gregorian date and a smaller Chinese lunar date or note underneath. Include colored holiday and solar-term tags across specific cells, with exactly 10 highlighted labels visible: “休十七” on the 4th, “清明节” on the 5th, “休十九” on the 6th, “谷雨” on the 20th in green, “劳动节” on the next-month 1st, “休十六” on the next-month 2nd, “休十七” on the last-row 3rd, “青年节” on the last-row 4th, “休立夏” on the last-row 5th, and “天后诞” on the last-row 9th in orange. Add small lunar phase markers on a few days, including yellow crescent or dot icons around the 2nd, 10th, 17th, 24th, and next-month 2nd. Make the 24 cell in the Friday column stand out with a rounded blue gradient tile and soft shadow, with smaller text “初八” inside. Beneath the calendar, show a detailed daily information panel separated by whitespace. The left side features a very large date title “4月24日”; the right side stacks “星期五 2026” and “农历三月初八”. Below that, include smaller gray metadata lines such as “第114天 · 第17周 金尊月” and a traditional sexagenary/date string like “丙午 · 马年 壬辰月 戊辰日”. At the far right of this metadata area, place a rounded outline pill button labeled “今日”. Underneath, present a large white rounded card with almanac guidance. The card contains two major sections with exactly 2 headings: a green “宜” section and a red “忌” section, separated by fine dotted dividers. In the “宜” section, include the directional fortune line “喜神 东南 福神 正北 财神 正北” and three activity items: “祭祀”, “修饰垣墙”, “余事勿取”. In the “忌” section, include the conflict line “冲煞 冲狗 煞南”. At the bottom, show a 5-item iOS-style tab bar with labels exactly “今日”, “MONTH”, “YEAR”, “EVENTS”, “MORE”; the first tab is active and includes the small sublabel “4月24日”. prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dark presentation contact sheet showing six anime cyberpunk character illustration variations generated from the same design, arranged as a 3-column by 2-row gallery on a charcoal background.

Canvas: Square image, approximately 768×850 px, dark gray page background with generous margins. Each artwork tile is vertical portrait format, evenly spaced, with a white caption beneath it. Use a clean sans-serif font, small to medium size, left-aligned under each tile.

Main character: A rebellious anime-style cyberpunk hero named E1, androgynous young adult with shaggy layered deep violet hair with golden-yellow underside streaks, sharp golden eyes where visible, pale skin, slim athletic build, and a confident dangerous expression. Outfit is a black hooded techwear jacket with yellow hazard-stripe accents, gold trim, triangular insignia patches, black cropped top with yellow emblem, strappy neckline, black cargo pants, belts, gloves, and heavy black boots with yellow laces. Overall palette is black, neon purple, electric violet, and warning-sign yellow.

Gallery layout: Include exactly 6 portrait illustration tiles, each with a distinct composition and caption:
1. Top-left tile caption: “E1 Rooftop Hero”. High-angle rooftop crouching pose above a dense neon city, purple holographic panels floating around, yellow warning triangle icon, dramatic rain-slick ledge and glowing skyscrapers. Add a soft square blur over the face.
2. Top-middle tile caption: “E2 Close-up Broadcast”. Tight close-up portrait from the chest up, hair blowing, purple broadcast interface graphics and city lights behind the character, intense neon rim light. Add a soft square blur over the face.
3. Top-right tile caption: “E3 Full-body Standing”. Full-body character standing on a wet rooftop walkway or fire escape, one hand reaching forward, skyscrapers and purple screens behind, yellow warning signs, glossy reflections on the floor.
4. Bottom-left tile caption: “E4 Livestream Stage”. Front-facing upper-body pose with one hand extended toward the viewer, surrounded by futuristic livestream UI panels, purple hologram screens, small hearts and counters, a bottom banner reading “THIS MESSAGE SHOULD NOT EXIST.” and a small “LIVE” badge.
5. Bottom-middle tile caption: “E5 Seedance Action”. Dynamic action pose, character lunging or sprinting diagonally across a rain-soaked cyberpunk rooftop, motion blur, neon purple city perspective, yellow warning icons, energetic cinematic angle.
6. Bottom-right tile caption: “E6 Softer Standard”. Cleaner softer portrait on a pale lavender tech-interface background, bust-up framing, same jacket and outfit, calmer lighting, minimal neon UI elements. Add a soft square blur over the face.

Visual style: Highly polished anime illustration, cyberpunk noir atmosphere, dramatic rim lighting, glossy wet surfaces, dense futuristic city detail, purple holograms, yellow hazard iconography, sharp linework, rich contrast, cinematic composition. The six tiles should look like consistent variations of the same character and world.

Constraints: Use exactly six tiles and exactly the six captions listed above. Preserve the contact-sheet layout and dark background. Keep the labels readable in English. Do not add extra panels, watermarks, logos, or unrelated characters. Use the background city theme rainy neon cyberpunk metropolis and overall mood dangerous heroic hacker-broadcast energy.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a black-and-white manga page about a fashionable young man meeting a tiny anthropomorphic hamster friend at a busy indoor shopping plaza.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, roughly 2:3 aspect ratio, clean white page with thin black outer border and thick black gutters. Highly detailed monochrome pen-and-ink line art with screentone-style shading, realistic architectural perspective, elegant shoujo/seinen manga character rendering.

Layout: Use exactly 6 panels. Panel 1 is a wide establishing shot across the full top width. Panel 2 is another wide panel below it. Panel 3 row has two panels: a narrow close-up of the man on the left and a wider hamster panel on the right. Panel 4 row has two panels: a narrow vertical hamster-hand gag panel on the left and a wider final panel on the right.

Setting: A modern indoor mall or station concourse with glossy tiled floors, tall glass storefronts, crowds of pedestrians, overhead direction signs, a circular indoor fountain, and a clothing store in the final panel. Include English signage such as “Central Plaza” on a directional sign and “SELECTED MEN'S WEAR” above the clothing shop, plus a small “NEW ARRIVAL” sign near the shop entrance.

Characters: The main human character is a tall handsome young man with tousled wavy dark hair, sharp eyes, a calm aloof expression, wearing a black long coat over a black turtleneck with a long scarf and pendant necklace. The small companion is a round fluffy hamster wearing a tiny beret and bow tie, holding or standing near a smartphone, expressive and cute.

Panel details: Panel 1: Wide establishing shot of the shopping plaza fountain from a distance. Many pedestrians walk around. The tiny hamster sits on the rim of the circular fountain, looking down at a smartphone, with small sound text near it. Panel 2: Medium-wide shot showing the handsome man in the left foreground, facing slightly right, noticing something; the fountain with the tiny hamster appears on the right side in the background. Panel 3 left: Tight close-up of the man’s face, serious and slightly puzzled. Panel 3 right: Close shot of the hamster on the fountain rim, waving one paw energetically while standing on or beside the smartphone. Panel 4 left: Comedic close-up of a human hand pinching and lifting the hamster gently by the tiny beret; the hamster dangles with startled paws. Panel 4 right: Final medium-wide shot in front of the menswear shop. The man stands in profile, holding the hamster on his open palm while looking toward the store window with suits and racks of clothes.

Visible text and effects: Include exactly 8 text elements: 1) the overhead sign “Central Plaza”; 2) small Japanese sound effect てちてち near the hamster in panel 1; 3) speech bubble from the man in panel 2 reading ん？; 4) silent speech bubble in panel 3 left reading “……” ; 5) hamster speech bubble in panel 3 right reading あ、こっちだよー; 6) large Japanese sound effect in panel 4 left reading “わしっ”; 7) small hamster speech bubble in panel 4 left reading “え？”; 8) final speech bubbles in panel 4 right: the man says “……ハムスターに似合う服を見に行くから服屋から回るぞ” and the hamster replies “えぇ…………”.

Style constraints: Do not use color. Keep the page polished and cinematic, with delicate hatching, realistic crowd silhouettes, crisp panel borders, detailed clothing folds, and expressive manga faces. The hamster should remain tiny compared with the man, creating a humorous contrast. Avoid extra panels, extra dialogue, watermarks, or modern UI overlays.\

Middle column shows exactly 3 separate prompt-layer example cards stacked vertically with plus signs between them. Right column shows the final composited sneaker poster. Bottom row contains exactly 2 comparison result cards on the left and exactly 3 recommendation cards on the right.

Left column details: Create 2 large rounded cards.
1. Top card, red warning style with red X icon. Title: “一次性生成（常见翻车原因）”. Body: “把所有元素塞进一个 Prompt”. Smaller explanation: “结果：构图 OK，但细节容易混乱，元素可能缺失或变形。” Include a small preview image of a futuristic running shoe floating over a sci-fi landscape with large Chinese text “未来已来” and tiny English “FUTURE IS NOW”.
2. Bottom card, green success style with green check icon. Title: “分层生成（推荐做法）”. Body: “每层只聚焦一件事”. Smaller explanation: “结果：每层精准可控，合成后整体效果更专业。” Inside this card, show exactly 3 mini layer rows with icons and labels: blue image icon row “背景层：场景 / 光线 / 氛围” with note “只描述环境、光照、色调、氛围”; purple cube icon row “主体层：角色 / 产品 / 动作” with note “只描述主体、材质、细节、姿态”; orange T icon row “文字装饰层：文案 / 图形 / 装饰” with note “只描述文字、排版、装饰视觉元素”.

Below it, create a cinematic finished advertisement: a detailed gray futuristic running shoe floating above reflective shallow water in a sci-fi alien landscape, with mountains and rocks, dawn light, a huge glowing circular portal/ring behind the shoe, and a large moon/planet in the upper right. At the bottom of the poster, include bold Chinese headline 未来已来, English subtitle FUTURE IS NOW, and small spaced feature words “轻盈 / 科技 / 突破”.
